senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. כחד; cmp. חֲסִי, חַסְיָא &c.)to fail, be reduced, be lean, opp. בריא, שמן.
units: <cite ref="Bava Kamma 34a:11">B. Kam. 34ᵃ</cite> <he>כ׳ כשעת וכ׳</he> if the injured ox became reduced after being wounded, damage is assessed according to the value at the time of standing before court; Y. ib. III, end, 3ᵈ <cite ref="K00469"><he>הִכְחִישׁ</he></cite>.

Gen. R. s. 53 (ref. to Hab. III, 17) כּוֹחֲשִׁים היו (Sarah’s face) was haggard (and the announcement of the angels made it shine like olive oil); Yalk. Hab. 565 כְּחוּשִׁים; [oth. interpret., v. infra].—Part. pass. כָּחוּשׁ, f. כְּחוּשָׁה; pl. כְּחוּשִׁים, כְּחוּשׁוֹת lean, reduced, weak.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 6b:14">B. Kam. 6ᵇ</cite> <he>אכל כ׳</he> if he ate fruits of a garden-bed with scanty fruits; <cite ref="Gittin 48b">Gitt. 48ᵇ</cite>; a. fr.

senses.gloss: (cmp. כָּזַב) to be false. Gen. R. l. c. כּוֹחֲשִׁים היו were they (the angels) false (deceiving)?—
to be reduced, fail, deteriorate. Y. B. Kam. l. c., v. supra.—
units: <cite ref="Meilah 17a:32-42">Meïl. 17ᵃ</cite> <he>מי שיש … יַכְחִישׁ וכ׳</he> if you have an enemy, do you desire him to be weak or strong? <cite ref="Meilah 17a:29-46">Ib.</cite> <he>ימולו … ויַכְחִישׁוּ</he> let their children be circumcised …, and they will become weak.
<cite ref="Yevamot 34b:4">Yeb. 34ᵇ</cite> <he>ויַכְחִישׁ יופיה</he> her beauty may be ruined. Y. M. Kat. I, beg. 80ᵃ <he>עמדה מלהַכְחִישׁ</he> if the field ceased to deteriorate; a. e.
<cite ref="Gittin 70a:19">Gitt. 70ᵃ</cite> <he>ג׳ … מַכְחִישִׁים כחו וכ׳</he> three things lessen a man’s energies.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 84b">Snh. 84ᵇ</cite> <he>הִכְחִישָׁהּ באבנים</he> he ruined the animal by loading stones upon her (without causing a wound). Y. B. Kam. l. c. <he>הִכְחִישׁוֹ חמשים וכ׳</he> he lessened his (the ox’s) value by fifty Zuz.
<cite ref="Esther Rabbah 1:1">Esth. R. to I, 1</cite> (play on <he>אח̇ש̇ור̇ש̇</he>) <he>שהכח̇יש̇ ר̇אש̇ן וכ׳</he> he caused haggardness to the heads of &c.
<cite ref="Shabbat 22a:7">Sabb. 22ᵃ</cite> <he>מַכְחִישׁ מצוה</he> he impairs the religious act (lessens the brightness of the Ḥănuckah lights).

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 67b">Snh. 67ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Chullin 7b">Ḥull. 7ᵇ</cite>, v. <he>כְּשָׁפִים</he>; a. fr.—[<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 627">Yalk. Ps. 627</cite> <cite ref="K00881"><he>אַכְחֵישׁ</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="K00970"><he>כָּעַס</he></cite>.]

senses.gloss: to declare false, deny, contradict, v. הַכְחָשָׁה.
units: <cite ref="Ketubot 20a:1">Keth. 20ᵃ</cite> <he>כשם שאין מזימין … אין מַכְחִישִׁין וכ׳</he> as an evidence of alibi cannot be taken up except by confrontation, so cannot contradictory evidence &c.

<cite ref="Berakhot 27b:18">Ber. 27ᵇ</cite> <he>יכול החי להַבְחִישׁ וכ׳</he> can the living contradict the living? <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 48">Gen. R. s. 48</cite>, beg. <he>מפני מה אתה מַכְחִישֵׁנִי וכ׳</he> why dost thou contradict me (declare me wrong) in the presence of my servant?—Sifra introd., v. <cite ref="K01257"><he>כָּרַע</he></cite>; a. fr.
<cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 356">Sifré Deut. 356</cite> <he>בשעת מְכַחֲשִׁים להם …</he> when the Israelites prosper, the nations flatter them; Yalk. Deut. 967.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 74b:8">B. Kam. 74ᵇ</cite> <he>עדים שהוּכְחֲשׁוּ בנפש</he> witnesses that have been contradicted in a capital case.—

<cite ref="Bava Kamma 74b:5">Ib.</cite> <he>מוּכְחָשִׁין</he> witnesses whose evidence has been contradicted (but not rebutted through an alibi). Keth. l. c. <he>עדות מוּכְחֶשֶׁת</he> a rebutted evidence; a. fr.
<cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 37:10">Sifré Deut. 37</cite> <he>מִתְכַּחֲשׁוֹת</he>; v., however, <cite ref="K01391"><he>כָּתַשׁ</he></cite>.
